title: Remote-viewed 'alien bases' turned out to be over-the-horizon radar sites

tellings.quote:
I did the three bases that uh that
supposedly are alien bases I drew all
three of them and all three of them when
I drew them back then were classified so
I could never talk about them publicly
but I told my the people who tased me
what they were I could say it now
because it's known they're over the
horizon radar sites

related.note: Both are about McMoneagle remote viewing the supposed alien mountain bases that Pat Price named. Here he says they were over-the-horizon radar sites, not alien command centers.

plain: Three mountain sites that some people call alien bases were, by the account of the former Army remote viewer Joe McMoneagle, really over-the-horizon radar sites, radar stations built to see past the curve of the Earth. McMoneagle, who practised remote viewing, the attempt to describe distant targets with the mind alone, says he drew all three when he was given them as targets. He says they were classified then, so he could only tell his handlers what they were, but that he can say it now because it is publicly known.
